scripts.build: npm run build -w @harness/core && npm run build -w @harness/server && node scripts/check-knowledge.mjs && npm run build -w @harness/web
scripts.check: npm run build -w @harness/core && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @harness/core && npm run build -w @harness/server && node scripts/check-knowledge.mjs && node --test apps/server/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.check:knowledge: npm run build -w @harness/core && npm run build -w @harness/server && node scripts/check-knowledge.mjs
